# Sandisk (SNDK): operating economics and conditional valuation

Status: DRAFT, awaiting independent audit. No canonical company or Site edits made. Research cut-off: October 18, 2026 PDT / October 19 UTC. Latest financial period reviewed: FY2026 ended July 3, 2026; 10-K filed August 17, accession 0001628280-26-057406. The next earnings release is scheduled October 29; FY2027Q1 is guidance, not an observed result. Model dollars are millions and shares millions.

## Eligibility and identity
SNDK is present in the supplied ticker inventory (Sandisk, sector 9, public, existing false). The issuer's 10-K cover registers SNDK common on Nasdaq Global Select. Robinhood's public SNDK stock page offers buying/selling the common stock. This proves public platform eligibility, not this user's account-specific permissions or an executable quote. Source: https://robinhood.com/us/en/stocks/SNDK/ (original HTML retained). Ignore that page's stale September quote for valuation.

The modern issuer separated from Western Digital February 21, 2025. Do not confuse its stock chart or capital structure with the pre-2016 acquired Sandisk. FY2026 is the first complete standalone fiscal year. FY2026 is 53 weeks, FY2025 52. Older WDC totals combine HDD and flash and cannot be used as Sandisk revenue.

## Business, mix, competitive position
Revenue is NAND products and solutions, not HBM DRAM. Datacenter includes enterprise SSDs; Edge includes PC, mobile, gaming, automotive and industrial/OEM solutions; Consumer includes retail removable storage and SSDs. FY2026 end-market sales: datacenter $5,153 (25.45%), edge $12,160 (60.05%), consumer $2,935 (14.50%). FY2025: $960/$4,127/$2,268. FY2024: $325/$4,069/$2,269. Quarter-four datacenter reached $2,977, or 33.2% of sales, while consumer fell sequentially to $556. Do not label all revenue AI revenue.

The investment case combines NAND process productivity, controllers/firmware, enterprise qualifications, channel/brand, and the Kioxia manufacturing relationship. Competitors named in the filing include Samsung, SK hynix, Micron, Kioxia itself, and YMTC. The physical technology and relationship barriers are real, but pricing power cannot be assumed permanent. High Bandwidth Flash is an emerging optionality, not an established revenue segment; no separate HBF revenue is inserted in the model.

## Ten-year study, honest comparability
history.csv contains 2017–2026 revenue, but only 2023–26 has Sandisk carve-out/consolidated financial statements in the reviewed reports. 2017–19 are WDC flash-product disclosures; 2020–22 segment gross profit excludes corporate/unallocated items. Earlier standalone EBIT, cash flow, debt and dilution are blank, not estimated. WDC's FY2023 flash revenue $6,063 differs from Sandisk's carve-out $6,086; the latter is used for current-issuer continuity. This is ten fiscal years of context, not ten comparable standalone operating years.

The cycle is severe: predecessor flash revenue fell from $9,949 in 2018 to $7,823 in 2019; from $9,753 in 2022 to $6,063 in the old 2023 segment. Segment gross margin was 30.0% in 2021, 36.2% in 2022 and 7.1% in 2023. Sandisk's FY2023/24/25/26 gross margins were 7.1%/16.1%/30.1%/71.5%. FY2025 goodwill impairment $1,830 is excluded from recurring economics but not erased from capital-allocation history. GAAP FY2025 EBIT of -$1,377 becomes +$453 by adding only that impairment; this is still not company non-GAAP EBIT $689.

FY2026 revenue $20,248, gross profit $14,472, EBIT $12,389, net income $11,433, CFO $11,671. The EBIT margin is roughly 61.2% by exact division; rounded report table shows 61.3%. Price/mix, not physical bits alone, drove the jump: annual bits increased mid-teens while revenue rose 175%. Nanya equity gains $808 are nonoperating and excluded from FCFF. Underutilization costs were $249/$75/$11 in FY2024/25/26, illustrating fixed-cost leverage.

## Guidance credibility and management claims
Four matched standalone forecast/actual pairs in guidance-track-record.csv all beat both upper revenue and non-GAAP EPS guide: revenue upside over high end approximately 4.9%, 14.2%, 24.0%, 8.7% for FY2026Q1–Q4. This documents near-term execution in an accelerating upcycle; it is not proof of long-run forecasting skill or a statistically reliable forecast-error distribution. Q1 FY2027 revenue guide $10.3–10.8B, non-GAAP EPS $44–46, diluted shares ~155M; no actual available at cut-off.

August 13 Investor Day targets for FY2028–30: mid/high-teens revenue growth, ~80% non-GAAP gross margin, ~75% operating margin, ~50% adjusted FCF margin. These are forward targets, not achieved results. The approximately 75% margin is not a GAAP guide; exclusions cannot be fully reconciled in advance. Model structural-reset path uses 74% after an explicit economic SBC allowance, not a silent GAAP relabeling. Tax, cash investment and working-capital requirements still reduce cash generation.

Management speech review (Q4 transcript, August 5): node transitions are the intended main source of bit growth; BiCS8 reached majority production; NBM pricing combines fixed terms with variable floors/ceilings. Management distinguished total expected contract revenue from unfulfilled RPO and stressed the difference between customer collateral and company cash. Revenue and margin tables are sourced to issuer documents, not transcription. Text source: https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/sndk/transcripts/658567-q4-2026/ .

Management interview review (Goldman September 9): CFO accepted a simplified description of NBM-covered supply carrying strong floor economics and uncovered supply retaining market pricing; executives tied capital efficiency to the JV's R&D and node roadmap. Those assertions require delivery, counterparty performance, enforceability and renewals. They do not establish an unconditional margin floor for the whole company. Text source: https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/sndk/transcripts/745215-goldman-sachs-communacopia-technology-conference-2026/ .

## Contracts: material evidence, not guaranteed receivables
10-K Note 4 records $59.8B RPO at July 3, $58.7B unbilled and about $1.1B recorded within contract liabilities, with approximately 19% expected in twelve months. Total contract liabilities are $1.242B. Subsequent-event Note 17 describes two further NBMs with transaction price $31.3B. Keep period-end and subsequent measures separate; $91.1B combined RPO is not a July3 asset or one-year revenue forecast.

Refund liabilities $1.5B principally represent returnable customer security deposits. Third-party collateral $5.0B is conditional on default/breach and not controlled by Sandisk, so never add it to cash or equity. NBM risks in Item1A include delivery/specification failure, penalties, termination/reduced volume after company breach, customer nonperformance, resale pricing risk and enforcement expense; guarantees may only partly compensate lost revenue. Executed full contracts are not in this package, and specific floor-price formulas/customer terms remain unavailable. The model deliberately brackets successful structural change and contract/cycle stress rather than assigning invented probability weights.

## Capital intensity and liquidity: why cash capex alone misleads
Own PPE capex FY2026 is $177, D&A $149. Cash loans to Flash Ventures were $462 with $187 repaid, net funding $275. A simple CFO minus own capex gives $11,494; also deducting net JV funding yields $11,219. Neither is recurring unlevered free cash flow: CFO includes security-deposit/refund growth $1,374, contract-liability growth $1,217, tax-payable growth $1,370, SBC $232 and other working capital changes. Do not annualize this cash conversion.

Sandisk owns 49.9% of the three Flash Ventures, takes roughly half output, pays half fixed costs even when underutilizing, and funds 49.9–50% of capital needs when JV operating cash is insufficient. All NAND wafers come from these ventures. Wafer prices already embed JV manufacturing/depreciation costs. Hence the model deducts incremental net JV financing alongside own capex, does not add back JV depreciation, and does not separately add JV going-concern equity value to operating EV.

Future commitment evidence: $6,559 Flash Ventures related cash requirements (including depreciation/leases, investments, R&D and Kioxia supply-availability payments), $4,902 purchase/other obligations and $299 operating leases in the MD&A cash-requirements table. Of total $11,760, $3,391 is within one year. These are not all incremental debt: many settle through forecast costs or reinvestment. Note11's minimum long-term commitment table totals $5,892 under a different scope; do not add both tables blindly. JV lease guarantees $923 are contingent; maximum estimable JV loss exposure $2,897 includes notes/investment, guarantees, inventory/prepayments. $1.2B Kioxia payments over 2026–29 support manufacturing through 2034, amortized through inventory/cost of revenue. Model net funding ratios are analyst assumptions, not contractual forecasts, and require periodic reconciliation.

Debt was repaid March4 2026. Revolver is undrawn $1.5B, matures February21 2030, covenant-conditioned. FY2026 buybacks $4.524B and withholding taxes on vested shares $630 demonstrate capital uses. August additional $14B authorization is optional, not already spent. Do not subtract authorization as debt or forecast automatic buyback accretion.

## Capital bridge, claims and valuation discipline
July3 cash $4,762 less refundable deposit reserve $1,500 less assumed minimum operating cash $1,000 yields $2,262 addable excess cash. Reserving deposits avoids treating customer money as surplus. Contract liabilities are dealt with through operating working capital, not deducted again as financial debt. Nanya marketable equity $1,777 is assigned a 25% analyst haircut, yielding $1,332.75; this is an illiquidity/valuation/tax cushion, not a verified fair-value estimate as of October. Financial debt $0. Operating leases $201 remain in operating expenses, so not also subtracted. JV guarantees get a separate stress, not a universal debt deduction. Unrecognized tax benefits $323 and other legal/tax/claim reserves require incremental-liability review to avoid double counting.

Common shares August7:146.419001M; FY2026 weighted-average diluted155M and Q1 guide~155M are proxies, not an exact valuation-date cap table. Outstanding RSU/PSU6.6M; PSUs can increase from1.4M target to3.6M maximum; ESPP obligations also exist. Unamortized award compensation $398. Forward SBC remains an operating cost (never added back), with existing award dilution approximated in the155M denominator; sensitivity158M. This approximates existing claims, not a full grant-level option model. No automatic future dilution plus full SBC double charge. Buybacks, post-July cash generation, changes in securities, awards and debt are not rolled to October: per-share values are conditional July3 anchors, explicitly not current fair-value claims.

## Replayable Damodaran-style FCFF framework
Run python replay_dcf.py. Inputs: model-inputs.json. Outputs: forecast.csv, model-output.json, sensitivity.json. Ten annual forecast years FY2027–36, terminal stage FY2037. Separate annual bit growth and ASP/mix change drive revenue; after-SBC operating margins drive EBIT; tax floors at zero with no immediate tax benefit on losses; reinvestment includes own capex, net JV funding, less own D&A plus incremental operating working capital. No projected working-capital release on revenue contraction, a conservative simplification. R&D is expensed, not capitalized; no unsupported innovation asset. Terminal reinvestment equals NOPAT×g/ROIC. Terminal WACC exceeds g in every case.

All scenario paths are explicit analyst assumptions. Structural-reset illustration honors the vicinity of management FY2028–30 margin/growth targets, then fades margins to35% by2036. Partial normalization fades to20%; contract-and-cycle stress includes a loss year and18% terminal margin. Reinvestment ratios deliberately exceed current own PPE capex, since excluding JV funding would exaggerate capital efficiency. However, revenue-linked net funding may overstate investment when prices spike and understate it when prices fall; the stress uses12% combined cash investment and is not a physical fab forecast. A per-bit capacity model requires additional unit/capex data.

WACC11%/12%/14% are judgmental risk assumptions, not observed market estimates: equivalent zero-debt CAPM inputs could be assumed risk-free4%, ERP5%, beta1.4/1.6/2.0. These inputs are not claimed as current empirical rates/betas. Terminal growth3%/3%/2.5%, ROIC25%/18%/15%, and cash tax20%/22%/25% are disclosed, not derived from the anomalous FY2026 effective tax rate. Sensitivities use9/11/13% WACC and2/3/4% growth for each operating scenario.

Illustrative results, July3 anchor, no probability weights:
- Structural reset: operating EV $268.66B; conditional equity $272.26B; $1,756.49 at155M shares; terminal value40.1% of EV.
- Partial normalization: EV $63.53B; equity $67.13B; $433.07 per proxy share; terminal34.2%.
- Contract/cycle stress: EV $8.97B; equity $12.57B; $81.07 per proxy share; terminal62.7%.
These spreads are the conclusion: durability/renewal of NBM economics dominates a false-precision point estimate. They are not investment recommendations or buy/sell signals. The stress scalar treats an economic regime change; contractual floors make it inappropriate to call it an ordinary spot-price downturn without execution/counterparty failure or later renewal deterioration.

Funding: retaining all cash produces no modeled external requirement, because early cash buffers later deficits. Distributing all positive FCFF leaves stress cash deficits after opening excess cash of $3.446B; using an assumed available$1.5B revolver leaves $1.946B. The revolver expires before some forecast losses, so this is a hypothetical refinancing-capacity sensitivity, not assured borrowing. No funding issuance price is invented. Buybacks would need suspension and/or refinancing/equity funding. Further JV guarantee-call stress subtracts up to$923M (about$5.95 per155M share) only if incremental to modeled losses, and cannot be double-counted against all$2.897B exposure components.

## Audit blockers and completion gate
Not ready for canonical admission until another reviewer checks retained sources, history classifications, guide-versus-actual dates, model math and all bridge assumptions. The packet is research-complete enough for audit but cannot claim ten comparable standalone years. Specific outstanding cautions:
- Post-July/through-October bridge is not reconstructed; no dated primary market quote used.
- Denominator is a disclosed diluted proxy; verify current common count/awards and repurchases before current per-share publication.
- Contract floor formulas, customer identities, full agreements and enforcement terms unavailable.
- Reported JV investment balance shows $678 on balance sheet versus$679 in Note10 component total; rounding/scope reconciliation requires review; neither is independently added to equity.
- Source data supports extraordinary recent margins, but the terminal economics and WACC remain assumptions. Do not replace uncertainty with management target certainty.
- Financing claims are conditional on access/refinancing and exclusion of unmodeled buybacks, deposit repayments beyond reserve, material legal claims and further strategic acquisitions.
